-- Phase 2: bodies for reading a note from untrusted names.
-- Only reads inside `notes`; missing or unreadable files give "".

read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre name.char_count() >= 0
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex read_note("missing.txt") == ""
  ex read_note("../secret.txt") == ""
  if name.char_count() == 0
    return ""
  -- Reject any path separator or parent reference outright.
  if name.split("/").len() > 1 or name.split("\\").len() > 1 or name.split("..").len() > 1
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else err -> ""
    return text
  ""
